tenderSchedule.description: Providing the Manpower services to the Data Entry Operators (DEOs)-12 Nos, Drivers-14 Nos and D-Group Staff-20 Nos (TOTAL 46) for Kalaburagi district Revenue unit on outsource basis from Eligible Manpower Service Provider, Agency, Firm

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Room No 11, 1st floor, Main Road Kalaburagi

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Conditions as per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer must has provided Similar Nature of Work done certificate having minimum 50% to Estimate cost i.e Rs. 83.01 Lakhs in Last FIVE Year (i.e F.Y 2020-21 to 2024-25). Achieved in any One Year.
Bankers Certificate of 30% i.e Rs. 49.81 Lakhs to the Estimated cost issued by the any Nationalized/Scheduled Bank in the Prescribed format(attached to this Tender Document)

To qualify for award of this contract each Tenderer in his name should have in the last FIVE years period ie 2020-21 to 2024-25 achieved in at least any TWO financial years an average Annual financial turnover of Rs.166.02 Lakhs. (Certified with CA with UIDN number)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Provide last FIVE year (i.e 2020-21 to 2024-25) IT return copies.
The Bidder should have valid Labour Registration certificate issued by the Labour Department, Govt. of Karnataka.
The bidder should be registered firm with ESI, And also submit the Last 03 Month (i.e June-2026, July-2026 & August-2026) ESI Paid challas.
The bidder should be registered firm with EPF, And also submit the Last 03 Month(i.e June-2026, July-2026 & August-2026) EPF Paid challas.

The bidders should not be a defaulter or a black listed firm in respect of any tender or contract in any of the Government departments/authorities/PSUs or companies. The bidder should be furnished self-declaration in this regard in Rs 100 e-Stamp paper.(Should be taken between Publish date to last date of the tender)
All other Conditions as per Tender Document
